data.name: Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike
data.detailed_description:
Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike is a driving simulator engaging and enjoyable that teaches the basics of driving immersing the player in a detailed and realistic urban environment. A tool widely used today by schools, government, driving-schools and health associations. Choose from a variety of scooter, small- and large-engine bikes as well as different scenarios. If you ever wanted to know how driving under influence will effect sight and reaction – now you can experience it yourself.

Features

  • Choose between utility scooters, small- and large-engine bikes
  • Cities, extra-urban and off-road scenarios
  • Realistic viability: one way roads, yield signs, traffic lights, pedestrians and much more...
  • Traffic offenses detection
  • Alcohol and drugs simulation

reviews.review:
Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike, developed and published by United Independent Entertainment, takes a very different direction from most motorcycle games available on Steam. Instead of emphasizing fast races, extreme stunts, or open-world exploration, it focuses on teaching the fundamentals of responsible riding. The game is designed as a learning tool that introduces players to traffic regulations, hazard awareness, and safe riding techniques through a structured simulation. While it can certainly be played by anyone interested in motorcycles, its greatest value lies in its educational purpose, making it a title that feels closer to a virtual training course than a traditional driving game.

The experience places players behind the handlebars of various motorcycles, from compact scooters to more powerful bikes, each offering a slightly different feel while navigating the roads. The environments include busy city streets, quieter suburban districts, and off-road sections, giving players opportunities to encounter a variety of road situations. Throughout these locations, realistic traffic systems play a central role. Drivers must obey traffic lights, stop signs, speed limits, pedestrian crossings, and lane rules while sharing the road with other vehicles. Rather than rewarding reckless behavior, the simulator encourages patience, observation, and careful decision-making, reinforcing habits that are valuable beyond the game itself.

One of the simulator's standout features is its effort to educate players about the dangers of impaired driving. It attempts to recreate the effects of alcohol and drugs on a rider's perception and reaction time, allowing players to experience how dramatically these substances can compromise safe vehicle control. Combined with a system that detects traffic violations and penalizes unsafe actions, the game consistently reminds players that every poor decision has consequences. This educational focus gives the simulator a distinct identity compared to entertainment-focused motorcycle titles, as every feature is designed to reinforce road safety rather than maximize excitement.

From a technical standpoint, the game reflects its age. The graphics are serviceable but lack the detail and visual polish found in newer driving simulations. Character models, environments, and vehicle textures are functional rather than impressive, while animations and environmental effects remain relatively basic. The motorcycle handling succeeds in providing an accessible riding experience, although seasoned simulation fans may find the physics too forgiving and lacking the complexity of more advanced motorcycle simulators. The gameplay can also become repetitive after extended sessions, since the emphasis remains on practicing safe driving scenarios instead of introducing a wide variety of objectives or progression systems.

Despite these limitations, Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike fulfills the purpose it sets out to achieve. It delivers a practical introduction to motorcycle safety, making it suitable for beginners, educational institutions, or anyone interested in reinforcing good riding habits. Its focus on realistic traffic behavior, defensive riding, and awareness of dangerous situations gives it an identity that few motorcycle games attempt to explore. Players looking for high-speed action or cutting-edge simulation technology may not find enough depth to keep them engaged for long, but those approaching it as a learning experience will likely appreciate its straightforward design and instructional value.

Overall, Safety Driving Simulator: Motorbike succeeds more as an educational simulator than as a conventional game. Its commitment to promoting safe riding practices, realistic traffic scenarios, and responsible decision-making helps it stand apart from more action-oriented motorcycle titles. Although the dated presentation and modest gameplay depth prevent it from reaching a wider audience, it remains a worthwhile option for players seeking a serious introduction to motorcycle safety rather than pure entertainment. 

Rating: 5/10
